questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an input device?
questions.e: A plotter draws output on paper, so it is an output device. Keyboard, scanner and mouse all feed data into the computer.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about units of data.
I. A nibble consists of 8 bits.
II. A bit can hold only 0 or 1.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only II is correct. A bit is a binary digit with value 0 or 1. A nibble is 4 bits; it is the byte that has 8 bits.

questions.q: In the binary convention used for computer memory, 1 MB is equal to
questions.e: Memory sizes go in powers of 1024: 1 KB = 1024 bytes and 1 MB = 1024 KB.

questions.q: Which of the following is a volatile memory?
questions.e: RAM loses its contents when power is switched off. ROM, flash and hard disk keep data without power.

questions.q:
Regarding computer ports, consider the following.
I. A PS/2 port is used to connect an Ethernet network cable.
II. A VGA port carries analog video signals to a monitor.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only II is correct. VGA carries analog video. Ethernet cables use the RJ-45 port, while PS/2 is for the keyboard and mouse.

questions.q: A network (Ethernet) cable is plugged into the ______ port of a computer.
questions.e: Ethernet LAN cables end in an RJ-45 connector. RJ-11 is the smaller connector used for telephone lines.

questions.q: What is the full form of BIOS?
questions.e: BIOS stands for Basic Input Output System. It is firmware that starts the hardware at power-on.

questions.q: The process of starting a computer and loading the operating system into main memory is called ______.
questions.e: Booting loads the OS kernel into RAM so that the computer becomes usable.

questions.q: When a PC is switched on, the BIOS first carries out
questions.e: POST (Power-On Self Test) checks the basic hardware such as RAM and keyboard before the OS is loaded.

questions.q: Which language translator converts assembly language into machine code?
questions.e: An assembler translates assembly language mnemonics to machine code. A compiler translates a high-level language.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about language translators.
I. An interpreter translates and executes a program one statement at a time.
II. A compiler translates the whole program before it is executed.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Both are true. An interpreter works statement by statement, while a compiler translates the entire program first and the translated code is run afterwards.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a file extension used for MS Word documents or templates?
questions.e: .xlsx is the Excel workbook format. .doc and .docx are Word documents, and .dotx is a Word template.

questions.q: The default file extension of a workbook saved in MS Excel 2016 is
questions.e: Excel 2007 and later use .xlsx. The older .xls is the pre-2007 format and .csv is plain text.

questions.q: A presentation created in a modern version of MS PowerPoint is saved by default with the extension
questions.e: The default PowerPoint format is .pptx. .ppt is the older format and .pps is a slide show file.

questions.q: Which of the following key combinations is NOT used for a clipboard operation (cut, copy or paste) in Windows?
questions.e: Ctrl+P opens the print dialog. Ctrl+C copies, Ctrl+X cuts and Ctrl+V pastes.

questions.q: In MS Word, which shortcut makes the selected text bold?
questions.e: Ctrl+B applies bold, Ctrl+I italic and Ctrl+U underline.

questions.q: Every formula in MS Excel must begin with the ______ sign.
questions.e: Excel treats an entry as a formula only if it starts with the equals sign.

questions.q: If cells A1, A2 and A3 of an Excel sheet contain 2, 4 and 6, what does `=SUM(A1:A3)` return?
questions.e: SUM adds all numbers in the range: 2 + 4 + 6 = 12.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an antivirus program?
questions.e: Photoshop is an image-editing program. The others are antivirus products.

questions.q: Which of the following is an impact printer?
questions.e: A dot-matrix printer strikes an inked ribbon with pins. Laser, inkjet and thermal printers are non-impact.

questions.q: In email, the abbreviation Bcc stands for
questions.e: Bcc means Blind carbon copy: recipients listed in it are hidden from the other recipients.

questions.q: The World Wide Web was invented by
questions.e: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the Web at CERN around 1989-91. Vint Cerf is a co-designer of TCP/IP.

questions.q: In Windows, files deleted from the hard disk are first moved to the ______ unless Shift is held while deleting.
questions.e: The Recycle Bin keeps deleted files so that they can be restored.

questions.q: Which key combination in Windows is used to switch between the open windows?
questions.e: Alt+Tab cycles through open applications. Alt+F4 closes the active window.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about MS Word shortcuts.
I. Ctrl + E centre-aligns the selected paragraph.
II. Ctrl + L right-aligns the selected paragraph.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only I is correct. Ctrl+E centres the paragraph. Ctrl+L left-aligns it; right alignment is Ctrl+R.
